channel.title: How to Kiss Better Blog
channel.description: Expert kissing advice, techniques, and tips from C.J. McKenna

item.title: Kiss on the Corner of the Mouth: Accident or Invitation?
item.description: A kiss on the corner of the mouth usually means they want more than your cheek but aren't sure. How to tell accident from invitation, and what to do next.

item.title: Signs the Kiss Meant Something to Him (And When It Didn't)
item.description: The real signs the kiss meant something to him show up after it ends: how he exits, whether he follows up and what next week looks like. Plus how to ask him.

item.title: What Does a Kiss on the Ear Mean? (And How to Do It Well)
item.description: A kiss on the ear usually means I want this to stay between us. What the earlobe, behind-the-ear, hug and whisper versions mean, and how to give one well.

item.title: What Does It Mean When Someone Gives You a Hickey?
item.description: Passion, pride, a dare or a message for someone else. What it means when someone gives you a hickey, what the spot says and when it turns into a red flag.

item.title: What Does a Peck on the Lips Mean? Who Gave It Matters
item.description: A peck on the lips is a one-second, closed-mouth kiss. What it means from a partner, a date, a friend or family, and what to do when all you get is pecks.

item.title: What Does a Kiss on the Nose Mean? (Plus the Nose Rub)

item.title: What Does a Kiss on the Shoulder Mean? (Sweater or Skin)

item.title: What Does a Kiss on the Lips Mean? Read the Context

item.title: What Does a Lingering Kiss Mean? (And How to Give One)
